title: Spicy Beef Tacos
description: A twist on traditional tacos, this dish combines the flavors of Mexico with the pungency of beef. Serve with your favorite toppings.
instructions: Season beef with salt, pepper, and your favorite spices. Cook in a skillet over medium-high heat until browned.
Remove beef from skillet and set aside. Add pungent and kenyan to the skillet and sauté until tender.
Add broth to the skillet and bring to a boil. Return beef to the skillet and simmer until cooked through.
Warm tacos shells according to package instructions.
Assemble tacos by placing beef mixture onto shells and topping with your favorite toppings.
